frontmatter.title: Terminal and console
frontmatter.description: Corelib console package, ANSI model, stream I/O split, and terminal events.

<SpecSection title="Scope" id="scope">
Terminal-facing corelib splits **byte stream I/O** (`System.Input`, `System.Output`, `System.Error` via `System.Syscall`) from **styled terminal output** (`corelib_console`: `Ansi`, `Console.Format`, controls, capabilities). Resize and tick delivery use **channels** or same-fiber **events**—no new runtime builtins beyond existing syscall and fiber surfaces.
</SpecSection>

<SpecSection title="Authority split" id="authority-split">
| Layer | Owns |
| --- | --- |
| [Console I/O streams](/platform-spec/core-library/terminal-and-console/console-io-streams/) | Stdin/stdout/stderr routing, UTF-8 bytes, `Result` vs panic on write failure |
| [ANSI escape model](/platform-spec/core-library/terminal-and-console/ansi-escape-model/) | ESC/CSI/OSC framing and normative sequence tables (aligned with repository `ANSI.md`) |
| [Console capabilities](/platform-spec/core-library/terminal-and-console/console-capabilities/) | TTY probe, `NO_COLOR` / `FORCE_COLOR`, color-model downgrade |
| [Console markup format](/platform-spec/core-library/terminal-and-console/console-markup-format/) | Beskid console markup → escape emission |
| [Console controls](/platform-spec/core-library/terminal-and-console/console-controls/) | In-terminal layout widgets (panel, progress, live tick) |
| [Console terminal events](/platform-spec/core-library/terminal-and-console/console-terminal-events/) | Resize polling and `ConsoleMessage` delivery |
</SpecSection>
